newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says aims to lift U.S. sales in '97.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says aims to lift U.S. sales in '97.

text.p: Volvo said on Friday it aimed to boost sales in the U.S. this year from the 1996 total of 87,586.

"We estimate...the introduction of the coupe model C70 and the new cabriolet will increase interest for Volvo and boost interest in our other models," Volvo Cars spokeswoman Jannine Fallon told Reuters by telephone from New Jersey.
"The aim this year is to increase sales from 1996 levels of 87,600 cars."
She declined to give an exact target level.
In calendar 1996 Volvo Cars increased its sales in the U.S. by 0.6 percent including a 20.4 percent rise in December, according to figures released on Friday.
The sharp rise at the end of the year was attributed to a leasing programme and promotion effort for future sales.
"In December we had a special leasing programme for our clients," Fallon said.
